decisions.reason: operator selected the engine when creating the project

decisions.decision: Unity project UBlade2 under unity/UBlade2; Godot implementation remains the reference until Unity accepts the gameplay/hero/capture gates
decisions.reason: Operator instruction: migrate the proven ProjectGypsy game/hero to Unity 6000.6.7f1 as the production pipeline. This is a port with acceptance evidence, not an engine toggle.

decisions.decision: Unity 6000.6.7f1 port accepted the gameplay, hero, build, demo and capture gates; the Godot implementation stays as the reference
decisions.reason: Build log UBLADE2_BUILD Succeeded bytes=97444534; demo GYPSY_DEMO_OK collected=3 frames=67 exit 0; 1280x720 capture inspected and pixel-checked; hero import 23 bones/clips idle,run,reach/Smile/512 maps; Gypsy toolpack passed=True. Mobile is not available (Android Build Support absent) and is not claimed.

decisions.decision: Add the mobile target: Unity Android Build Support installed and a signed debug APK built, installed and launched on the local API 35 emulator
decisions.reason: Unity CLI installed the Android module and child modules; BuildUBlade2.BuildAndroid produced com.c7imi.ublade2 (ARM64 IL2CPP, Vulkan, debug-signed, minSdk 26, target 36); on-device logcat shows UBLADE2_START, UBLADE_HERO_OK and GYPSY_DEMO_OK collected=3. A clear mobile visual capture is outstanding (UB2-D15).

decisions.decision: Park the mobile target: UltraBlade 2 is a PC-only game for this milestone
decisions.reason: The operator directed that the current game be PC only. The Android build/launch evidence and the partial mobile capability are preserved for a later decision, but mobile is not part of the playable release and is not claimed as complete.
